node.statement: By 1.5, applied to the index i whose row point is the display point p_v, the transverse component of the fiber-aggregated idempotence equation reads x_v = sum_Q c^{(v)}_Q * x_Q, where c^{(v)}_Q denotes the display row's fiber-aggregated mass on fiber Q.
